name: DataBarBorder
description: Represents the border of the data bars specified by a conditional formatting rule.
remarks: Use the DataBarBorder object to get or set the color and border type for data bars. To access the DataBarBorder object associated with a data bar conditional formatting rule, use the BarBorder property. After retrieving the DataBarBorder object, use its Color property to return a FormatColor object that you can use to set the color of the data bars.
example:
Range("A1:A10").Select
Range("A1:A10").Activate

Set myDataBar = Selection.FormatConditions.AddDatabar
With myDataBar.BarBorder
 .Type = xlDataBarBorderSolid
 .Color.ThemeColor = xlThemeColorAccent2
 .Color.TintAndShade = 0
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of border for data bars specified by a conditional formatting rule. Read/write.

properties.name: Color
properties.description: Returns an object that specifies the color of the border of data bars specified by a conditional formatting rule. Read-only.
